issues.evidence: CSV row-hypergraph, Incidence, and CSR/CSC CSV routes share the same quote-state-aware full-line comment masking. Strict parseCsvDocument behavior remains unchanged.

Auto Detect masks H2H-looking payload only while RFC quote syntax is lexically valid and balanced. Invalid RFC quote syntax uses comment-masked raw structure for H2H evidence; malformed CSV without a structural H2H signature still routes to CSV.

expH2HResult returns structured success/refusal state while expH2H remains a string compatibility wrapper. H2H refusal text remains previewable/copyable, but UI and agent download paths return before invoking the downloader and do not return a filename.

contracts.h2hQuotePolicy: Lexically valid and balanced RFC quotes protect payload. Invalid/unclosed RFC quoting cannot hide a credible structural H2H signature.
contracts.successfulH2HExportInvariant: Every identifier class accepted by expH2HResult must produce text that Auto Detect classifies as h2h and parseInputFormat('h2h') consumes without identifier corruption.
contracts.identifierRefusalDownload: Preview and copy remain available as diagnostic text; H2H data download returns ok:false and no filename without invoking dl().
contracts.overBudgetH2HBehavior: Preserved separately. A non-computed projection has no identifier assessment result and retains the pre-existing projection diagnostic behavior.
